project.title: Bacterial community composition in biofilm and sediments of a river influenced by wastewater treatment plant effluents
project.description: This study evaluated the bacterial populations of biofilm and sediments of the Ter River (Ripoll, Spain) using bacterial tag-encoded FLX-titanium amplicon pyrosequencing.
